name: Video SimpleQA
intro: Video SimpleQA是一个旨在评估大型视频语言模型（LVLMs）事实性基础的综合基准。它通过多跳事实追溯问题、短形式确定性答案和时间定位要求，专注于视频上下文中的事实性评估。该基准要求模型整合视频显式叙述之外的外部知识，并对模型进行细粒度、逐步评估。研究发现，当前LVLMs在事实遵守方面存在显著缺陷，且模型普遍过度自信。
scale: 1,079个视频、1,504组最终问答，并附逐事实子问答
intro_en: Video SimpleQA is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the factual grounding of large video language models (LVLMs). It focuses on factual assessment within video contexts through multi-hop fact-tracing questions, short-form definitive answers, and temporal localization requirements. The benchmark requires models to integrate external knowledge beyond explicit video narration and provides fine-grained, step-by-step evaluation. Studies show that current LVLMs have significant deficiencies in factual compliance and tend to be overly confident.
scale_en: 1,079 videos and 1,504 final QA pairs, plus per-fact sub-QAs

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.18923, Sections 3.1-3.3, 4.1-4.2, and Table 4. Construction and evaluation are pinned to the paper version represented by this identifier.. The paper builds multi-hop video QA from Wikimedia Media of the Day and encyclopedic evidence. A generator and critic iterate for at most three rounds; experts refine and decompose questions, four models gate difficulty, two annotators must both accept, and answers receive a final authority and safety audit. The released set has 1,079 videos and 1,504 final QA pairs, including 928/469/107 two-/three-/four-hop questions, alongside per-fact sub-QAs. The same o3 three-way factuality judge and F-score protocol is applied to final multi-hop QAs and decomposed sub-QAs, whose results are reported separately for fine-grained hop analysis.
